rows.name: label
rows.description: Label to be shown on popover top

rows.name: closeButtonLabel
rows.description: Label for close button as read by screenreader. @deprecated Use closeButtonProps.label instead.

rows.name: closeButtonProps
rows.description: Props for the close button (accessibility and behavior only, style is managed internally)

rows.name: actionSlot
rows.description: Dynamic actions of popover. Suggested Preferred Content: ODSPopoverPreferredActions

rows.name: text
rows.description: Text to be shown under popover label

rows.name: closeIcon
rows.description: Icon to be rendered for the close button. Accepts an SVG React component. If it is not set the default icon will be used.

rows.name: placement
rows.description: The placement of the arrow can be placed at the top, bottom, left or right of the popover

rows.name: alignment
rows.description: The placement of the arrow can be aligned on the left hand, right hand or centrally on the popover

rows.name: defaultOpen
rows.description: The initial value for the open state.

rows.name: open
rows.description: Whether the sheet is open or not. Use together with onOpenChange.

rows.name: onOpenChange
rows.description: Fires when the open state changes.

rows.name: offset
rows.description: Offset (in pixels) of popover from Trigger element

rows.name: arrowOffset
rows.description: Offset (in pixels) of popover from Trigger element

rows.name: trigger
rows.description: Element that will be used as trigger for the popover to open
